title: Draft tier 2 execute-at-close gates behind a policy flag
description: STATUS: intentionally left in draft pending an owner decision - do not mark ready or claim without it; the epic explicitly scopes tier 2 as proposal-only. WHY: tier 1 matching still trusts that the agent ran the command it recorded; the only full fix is executing declaredCommand at closeout and recording output as evidence automatically. The building block exists: runBoundedProcess in @boreal/core (packages/core/src/process-runner.ts) already provides timeout and output caps and is used by the SQLite cache (packages/storage/src/sqlite-cache.ts lines 394-418). WHAT (when approved): a gate execution mode behind a new RuntimePolicy flag (packages/core/src/policies.ts) defaulting off, executing in the workspace root with bounded output, auto-recording evidence with the captured output, passing on exit code zero plus expectedObservable match. Open questions for the owner recorded here for the eventual designer: sandboxing and command provenance (only filer-declared strings, never runtime-assembled), cwd and environment contract, non-determinism handling, and interaction with reservation ownership. Produce a design note first, not code.
acceptanceCriteria: Design note in docs/decisions covering policy flag, sandboxing, cwd contract, evidence auto-recording and failure semantics
Owner sign-off recorded before any implementation task is filed
closedReason: Tier 2 execute-at-close design note completed; implementation remains gated on future owner sign-off.
